name: Window Controls
author: Fabio Pauli
description: Minimize and close the focused window from the bar, and restore minimized windows from a dropdown.

barWidget.description: Titlebar-style minimize and close buttons for the focused window, plus a list of minimized windows.

schema.label: Minimized list
schema.description: Show the button that lists minimized windows.

schema.label: Minimize button
schema.description: Show the minimize button while the focused workspace has a window.

schema.label: Close button
schema.description: Show the close button while the focused workspace has a window.

schema.label: Hide list when empty
schema.description: Hide an empty list on occupied workspaces; empty workspaces always omit an empty list.

schema.label: Show count
schema.description: Show the number of minimized windows next to the list glyph.
